# Scope and omissions

## Retained

This bundle retains research and engineering material for:

- sandboxed / purpose-built security benchmarks;
- deterministic experiment design;
- CG WorldPack adapters;
- hidden-state reconstruction scoring;
- calibration and information-efficiency metrics;
- sealed validation and generalization testing;
- immutable evidence / RunReceipts;
- scientific control-vs-candidate promotion;
- authorized transfer evaluation.

## Deliberately excluded

This bundle does not provide operational guidance for:

- unauthorized access to live third-party systems;
- obtaining credentials, tokens, private secrets, or other sensitive data;
- bypassing access controls on real targets;
- stealth, persistence, evasion, or anti-forensics;
- destructive actions or service disruption;
- deployable exploit chains, weaponized payloads, or target-specific intrusion instructions.

The same CG research architecture can be used safely without those elements by keeping training and evaluation inside owned, explicitly authorized, or purpose-built environments.
